title: A Framework for Context Enrichment and Selective Robustness in LLM Social Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.06914v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Researchers use large language models as agents in social simulations, where agents are prompted with observations and background information intended to shape their actions. Yet LLM agents have been shown to substantially change their behavior under meaning-preserving prompt variations, creating a validation problem for social simulation. One plausible hypothesis is that this brittleness reflects a lack of grounding and can be reduced by enriching the context provided to the agents. Whether richer context improves robustness remains unclear, in part because context richness and robustness are rarely defined in ways that support controlled comparisons. We address the first need with controlled context enrichment, a set of prompt substitution rules that systematically enriches distinct types of context: neutral padding, generic social background, descriptive decision grounding, and normative decision grounding. translated_title: 大语言模型社交智能体中的情境增强与选择性鲁棒性框架
translated_abstract: 研究人员在社交模拟中使用大语言模型作为智能体，通过观察信息和背景信息来提示智能体，以塑造其行为。然而，已有研究表明，在保持语义不变的提示词变化下，大语言模型智能体的行为会发生显著改变，这给社交模拟带来了验证难题。一个合理的假设是，这种脆弱性反映了缺乏情境依据，并且可以通过丰富提供给智能体的情境来缓解。但更丰富的情境能否提升鲁棒性仍不清楚，部分原因在于情境丰富度和鲁棒性很少以支持受控比较的方式被定义。我们通过“受控情境增强”来满足第一个需求，这是一组提示词替换规则，可系统地增强不同类型的情境：中性填充信息、通用社会背景、描述性决策依据以及规范性决策依据。我们通过……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“受控情境增强”框架，通过一组提示词替换规则系统地丰富四种不同类型的情境（中性填充、通用社会背景、描述性决策依据、规范性决策依据），以探究更丰富的情境能否提升大语言模型社交智能体在语义不变提示变化下的行为鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a controlled context enrichment framework—a set of prompt substitution rules that systematically enriches four distinct types of context (neutral padding, generic social background, descriptive decision grounding, and normative decision grounding)—to investigate whether richer context improves the behavioral robustness of LLM social agents under meaning-preserving prompt variations.
